content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-x02-_h_ojidf/report.rdl

Export page 1 of this report as a PDF for me.

I can't export this report as a PDF. My tools read and edit the .rdl file's structure (data sources, datasets, parameters, tablixes, charts, and layout), and none of them render pages or produce PDF output.

To get a PDF of page 1, you can:

- **Open the report in Power BI Report Builder** and use **File > Save As > PDF**, or run it in the report viewer and use **Export > PDF**. To limit it to page 1, set the page range to 1 in the export dialog.
- **Use Power BI Report Server or the Power BI service**, if the report is published there. Open the report, choose **Export > PDF**, and set the page range.

I can still help with the report itself, such as checking it for errors with `verify_report` or adjusting the layout before you export.
